title: Reflex relay envelope
description: What an orchestrator passes from one agent hop to the next. Built from the engine's output (IPC responses, or reflex generate/system1 --json for cold hops) and the orchestrator's own state. The engine never reads or writes it.

agent.description: Orchestrator state: the role that produced this hop.

hop.description: Orchestrator state: the hop's position in the chain.

decision.description: A System-1 decision: the chosen candidate.

label.description: The chosen candidate: its text, or the orchestrator's name for it.

entropy.description: Entropy of the candidates' distribution, in nats.

carry.description: Generated text handed to the next agent (IPC text; reflex generate --json: token_text).

kv.description: Orchestrator state: a cache file the next agent can resume from (import_kv / --import-kv).

dtype.description: The export_kv_dtype the file was written with.

timings.description: Milliseconds and slot facts. IPC timings for warm hops; the CLI's --json line for cold hops; wall_ms is measured by the orchestrator.

wall_ms.description: Orchestrator: the request's round trip, or a cold process's spawn to exit.

kv_io_ms.description: Cache file read (with upload) and write, or the pinned prefix copy.

pinned_seq_len.description: IPC pinned_seq_len: positions in the process's pinned slot after the request.

pinned_bytes.description: IPC pinned_bytes: VRAM held by the pinned slot after the request.
